name: semgrep-static-analysis
description: Assimilates Semgrep local static-analysis scans into Ouroboros audit, provenance, and handoff artifacts while preserving Semgrep CLI UX.

commands.name: scan
commands.summary: Run a bounded read-only Semgrep scan and attach normalized findings as Ouroboros evidence.

arguments.name: target_path
arguments.description: Repo-relative file or directory to scan.

arguments.name: config
arguments.description: Local Semgrep config path by default, or a registry/URL config only when remote configs are explicitly enabled.

capabilities.name: ledger
capabilities.reason: Record scan invocation, policy inputs, and summary verdict.

capabilities.name: provenance
capabilities.reason: Record Semgrep version, config source, target paths, and output hashes.

capabilities.name: handoff
capabilities.reason: Attach normalized findings for downstream review or automated remediation.

capabilities.name: progress
capabilities.reason: Report scan progress and completion status.

permissions.reason: Read target source files and local Semgrep rule files.
Invoke the installed Semgrep CLI with bounded arguments.
Only needed when using Semgrep registry, URL, or remote configs.
